description: This file implements weight normalization utilities for PyTorch modules, including the WeightNorm class, functions to apply and remove weight normalization, and related internal logic.

classes.name: WeightNorm
classes.description: Class implementing weight normalization logic, including applying, computing, and removing weight normalization hooks on modules.

methods.name: compute_weight
methods.description: Computes the weight tensor with normalization applied, based on stored parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to apply weight normalization to a module parameter.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes weight normalization from a module, restoring original weights.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Updates the module's weight attribute with the normalized weight.
